opportunities.theorem: For every finite d, every positive frame Q=sum_i |A_i><A_i| of traceless Hermitians, and every legal symmetric tripartite Choi state R with all one-register marginals I/d and AB channel unital, TP, and HS-self-adjoint, prove Tr(R H_Q) >= V(Q)-k(Q), where H_Q=1/2 sum_i[(A_i^{T,A}-A_i^B)^2+(A_i^{T,A}-A_i^C)^2]. Equivalently 2s_Phi(Q)<=V(Q)+k(Q), hence the proposed universal comparison with sharp C=2.
opportunities.importance: Would establish dimension-independent common-EB deficit control; the exact isotropic depolarizing family makes C=2 sharp.

primary_sources.relevance: Exact 1/2 QMC product-state rounding via triangle monogamy; comparison mechanism for positive two-body objectives.

primary_sources.results: Theorems III.2 and III.8; isotropic parameterization in Section III.1
primary_sources.relevance: Exact isotropic two-output extension boundary; complete-frame depolarizing example attains ratio 2.
A known dimension-dependent separable conversion for the stronger Bose-symmetric-extension class.
Trace-symmetric QMS Poincare estimate under a spectral gap; exact assumptions delimit the Dirichlet-form analogy.

opportunities.mechanism: Rewrite the score defect as the expectation of a positive sum of squared pairwise differences, then prove a lower-bound rounding theorem against the minimum tracial product-extension cost.
opportunities.load_bearing_missing_lemma: A centered, frame-uniform inequality preserving all tracial one-register marginals and valid for every legal two-output Choi extension; ordinary multiplicative max-energy rounding has an additive offset and is insufficient.
compatibility_obligations: One tracial ensemble must serve the full frame Q.
R must be a legal common broadcaster Choi state with all marginals I/d and HS-self-adjoint channel marginal.
The bound must be linear in V-s down to arbitrarily small deficit and dimension-independent.
Do not replace swap-invariant extensions by Bose-support extensions without proving equivalence.
opportunities.early_falsification_check: In d=2, diagonalize an arbitrary positive 3x3 frame covariance by a common Bloch rotation and compute the exact support over swap-symmetric three-qubit states with I/2 marginals; compare with V+lambda_max(Q).
opportunities.decisive_counterexample_standard: For C=2, exhibit exact legal data with V-k>2(V-s) and certify k over all tracial pure-state ensembles. For no finite C, exhibit a legal sequence with (V-k)/(V-s) unbounded.
opportunities.known_exact_calibration: For the full traceless orthonormal frame and depolarizing channel lambda=(d+2)/(2(d+1)), isotropic two-extendibility is exact at Phi+=(d+1)/2 and (V-k)/(V-s)=2.
not_established: No legal integrality-gap family violating C=2 or all finite C.
No conversion from QMC maximum-energy approximation to the target minimum-cost deficit bound.
